children: is warning investors to expect a softer fourth quarter as a next-generation pickup transition temporarily reduces truck deliveries, while management also sees 2027 becoming a difficult year for electric vehicles. The near-term weakness looks largely operational, but the bigger investor issue is whether GM can protect truck profits while making its EV business sustainably profitable.
CFO Paul Jacobson said at Morgan Stanley's Laguna Conference that GM expects roughly 35,000 fewer truck deliveries during the changeover to its next-generation pickups.
Fourth quarter is typically seasonally weaker than Q2 and Q3 this yearseasonally less than 35K units is about the right way to think about Q4."

That matters because pickups and SUVs remain critical profit engines for GM's North American business. In the second quarter, GM generated $48 billion of revenue and $3.9 billion of adjusted EBIT, while North America delivered an 8.6% adjusted EBIT margin. GM also raised its full-year 2026 guidance for the second time this year.
The bigger question is what happens after the truck transition.
Jacobson said 2027 is going to be a bit of a flat spot for EVs as profitability remains under pressure.

EV profitability has been hit really hard over the last couple of years. First, tariffs; second, everybody was logging EV credits as part of the variable profit equationboth of those went the wrong direction against profitability.
GM still believes EVs are a long-term opportunity, but we've got to get them profitable, Jacobson said.
The key near-term issue is whether the 35,000-unit truck shortfall proves temporary and whether pricing holds during the model transition.

GM's next major checkpoint comes October 20, when it reports third-quarter results. Investors should watch updated 2026 guidance, North American margins, truck inventories and progress reducing EV losses.

A clean pickup transition could make Q4 weakness relatively easy to look through. Persistent EV losses or weaker truck economics, however, would make Jacobson's warning about 2027 more important to the stock.

title: General Motor Investors Get Fresh Warning About 2027
